title: Subscription Recommitment Runway - Aug 2027
description: Lightweight runway-style tracker for mid-market subscription renewals where renewal conversations have cooled. Designed for weekly scrubs and to test two specific playbooks (exec-sponsor and usage-incentive). Use this as a working sheet for CS leads ahead of QBR reviews.
